title: Northgate Care Protection Plans Coverage Summary
content:
The failures a Northgate Care Protection Plans contract covers are set plan by plan by the switches in this summary. A figure of 0 marks a threshold that does not apply to that plan.

## Failure types covered

| Plan | Mechanical and electrical failure from normal use | Power surge | Accidental damage (drops, spills, cracked screens) | Accidental stains | Structural failure (frame, spring, support) | Cosmetic damage not affecting function | Built-in batteries |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | Yes |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No | No |

## Stain types and failure thresholds

| Plan | Stain types covered | Mattress body impression depth counted as structural failure (inches) | Battery capacity below which a covered battery counts as failed (percent) | Dead pixels at which a display counts as failed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | none | 0 | 80 | 3 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | none | 0 | 80 | 3 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | none | 0 | 80 | 1 |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | food and beverage; bodily fluids; ink and dye | 1.5 | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | none | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | none | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the thresholds

- **Battery capacity (the three electronics plans, 80 percent).** A built-in battery holding less than 80 percent of its capacity counts as failed; a hypothetical battery holding 79 percent counts as failed, and one holding exactly 80 percent does not.
- **Dead pixels.** On the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan and the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan a display counts as failed at 3 or more dead pixels, so a hypothetical display with 2 dead pixels does not and one with 3 does. On the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection a single dead pixel is enough.
- **Mattress sag (Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan, 1.5 inches).** A body impression at least 1.5 inches deep counts as a structural failure; a hypothetical 1.5-inch impression qualifies and a 1.25-inch impression does not.
- Accidental damage is switched on for one plan only, the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection; stains and structural failures for one plan only, the Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan. No plan covers cosmetic damage that does not affect function.
